definition: Tokenizers is a fast Rust library, with Python bindings, for training and running BPE, WordPiece and Unigram tokenizers.
details: Developed by Hugging Face (Anthony Moi and team) in 2019.

explainer.lead: How to install Hugging Face Tokenizers, a first working example, and where it fits in an AI project.

quickstart.python:
from tokenizers import Tokenizer, models, trainers, pre_tokenizers

tok = Tokenizer(models.BPE(unk_token="[UNK]"))
tok.pre_tokenizer = pre_tokenizers.Whitespace()
tok.train(["corpus.txt"], trainers.BpeTrainer(vocab_size=8000, special_tokens=["[UNK]"]))
print(tok.encode("Tokenizers split text into pieces.").tokens)

explainer.inAi: Every Transformers model ships a tokenizer.json built with this library; train your own when working with a new language or domain.
